messages.subject: RE:  Parts Campaign – Stock Reduction of Hitachi Branded Fuel Filters
messages.bodyPreview: Hi Ronald, Thanks for the update. We will await your comments after your meeting regarding this topic. Regarding the SPA net price, Based on the ISZE sales history, we observe a significant decline in volume. This leads us to believe that end users may increasingly be opting for lower-cost solutions within the non-genuine aftermarket. Do you agree with this statement? Part Nr 2021 2022 2023 2024 2
